reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing-validation finding: the issue is auth is NOT enforced; also public HTTP route). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in scope file; attack entry point is unauthenticated external HTTP request (untrusted). Gate 3: src/app/api/ is explicitly in-scope and 'Force-logout-all time gate bypass' is listed verbatim in key_security_concerns. An attacker can trigger this via GET /api/admin/force-logout-all by sending arbitrary non-empty cookie values (e.g., Cookie: oauth_user_id=x; oauth_access_token=y) during the 22:50–23:50 JST window, causing the middleware (middleware.ts:38) to pass the request through and forceLogoutAll() (route.ts:28) to execute — force-logging out all currently checked-in users with no identity or admin role check whatsoever.
